subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate coverage as sufficient proof for this provider-side, non-inducible xAI/Grok stale encrypted_content error?
rationale: The code path and tests are clear, but the external-PR real-behavior gate normally requires after-fix proof and the author says the exact provider error cannot be induced on demand without testing a different failure path.

options.title: Grant Proof Override
options.body: Accept the source-level reproduction, green checks, pre-fix production logs, and prior proven retry path as enough for this narrow predicate change.

options.title: Wait For Organic Capture
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real xAI rotation occurs and the contributor can attach redacted after-fix retry logs.

options.title: Reject Narrow Mitigation
options.body: Close or pause this PR in favor of a broader provider-error classification design instead of changing this retry predicate now.

recommendation.title: Grant Proof Override
recommendation.body: Accept the source-level reproduction, green checks, pre-fix production logs, and prior proven retry path as enough for this narrow predicate change.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the closest prior same-predicate recovery change and is the best available history owner for proof-sufficiency judgment.
